pr_title: [Feature] add synthetic mode for speculative decode
source_quote: Raise error instead? Maybe users will incorrectly use them. But, more importantly, I think the `using_block_verify` and `using_entropy_verify` flags are also weird. Why do we judge them in runtime instead of `__init__`? That makes your runtime modification `using_block_verify = False` become weird, too.

rule.description: 当两个模式/标志/配置在实现层面语义互斥（例如 synthetic 要求 first-reject 逐 token，但 block_verify 走 cumprod 联合；又如 `--pipeline-parallel-size > 1` + `--single-device`）时，**不得**在运行时静默把某一方"强制覆盖为 False / 默认值"。若降级是安全的（语义能保持一致、只是性能下降），也必须在改 flag 前用 `logger.warning_once` 明确告知用户："你配的 A 与 B 冲突，已自动把 A 降级为 X"。若降级不可安全推导（可能静默出错或行为不可预期），应直接 `raise ValueError` 并给出解决步骤。
checkpoints: 搜索 `if FEATURE_A: flag_b = False`、`if MODE_X: cfg.enable_y = None` 这种"在函数体中部静默改外部 / 局部 flag"的写法
重点区域：sampler / kernel launch wrapper / engine initialization / patch 代码 (monkey patch 里经常"如果有冲突就悄悄跳过")
检查 raise/logger 覆盖：抛错的信息是否包含 "what conflicted", "why incompatible (one line)", "how to fix — which flag to turn off / which alternative" 三段
对 `using_block_verify = ... and get_config().enable_X` 这种"每步 forward 重新 get_config"的 bool 解析，评估是否能提至 init 级别

diff.unified:
--- a/vllm_ascend/sample/rejection_sampler.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/sample/rejection_sampler.py
@@ -15,9 +15,16 @@
         get_ascend_config().rejection_sampler_config.enable_entropy_verify
     )
 
-    # 静默降级：用户不知道自己的 block_verify 被关掉了
-    if synthetic_mode:
-        using_block_verify = False
+    # Synthetic mode uses per-token rate acceptance with first-rejection
+    # semantics, which is incompatible with block-verify's joint (cumprod)
+    # verification. Raise error instead of silently disabling.
+    if synthetic_mode and using_block_verify:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "synthetic_mode is incompatible with block-verify "
+            "(joint verification). Please disable block-verify when "
+            "using synthetic rejection sampling. Synthetic acceptance "
+            "requires the standard per-token random kernel."
+        )
 
     if using_block_verify:
         # block verify 路径 ...
